AI Preferences

AI actions copy the prompt and shot data to your clipboard, then open your chosen AI site for you to paste manually. TrackPull does not send the data automatically.

Portal Archive Export

Export every supported Course Play and Map My Bag activity you can see in Trackman Portal into local files.

  • You must be logged into portal.trackmangolf.com; TrackPull uses your browser session only.
  • Data stays local until your browser downloads the CSV, manifest, and failure report files.
  • Requests are allowlisted, sequential, and throttled so the portal is treated respectfully.
  • Progress is saved locally, so you can pause, resume after reopening settings, cancel, or retry failed items.
